description:
Ostro Organics is a family-owned and operated oil mill in Victoria BC Canada. We cold-press culinary oils under as little pressure as possible to maintain all of its natural occurring nutrients. Once the oils is in the barrel, we let the oil sludge settle to the bottom before decanting the pure oil, This allows us to offer highest quality, premium oils, raw, unfiltered and unrefined. The oils are ideally stored in the fridge, used within 6-12 months on salads, smoothies, dipping and light frying.

We are very selective and picky when sourcing our raw materials. Not every nut or seeds qualifies to suit our standards. Organic, whole, flawless quality that you would choose for snacking, is what we strive for seeing in our premium oils.

Finding the right suppliers that have the products that you are looking for has proven to be a real challenge. Sourcing products locally and regionally is not always possible due to the climatic conditions we face on the west coast of British Columbia.

Keeping in mind that the kernels, seeds and nuts that we buy are the base for extraordinary healthy oils, we look near and far, in order to get the quality we want. For example, when dealing with organic almonds, we look for suppliers that do not pasteurize their crop after harvest.

The extra amount of time spent in sourcing great products sure pays off when looking at the result. Ostro Organic Oils are exquisite in taste, color and scent.

We are a small business but hope to bring the joy of unfiltered, hand crafted culinary oils to more homes. If you are interested in helping us spread the word, please contact us and sign up to our affiliate program.

We focus on certified organic, raw, slow food movement, vegan friends, our facility is peanut free, dairy and gluten free!

All oils are hand crafted, bottled, capped and labelled in house.

Check our website for more information and don't hesitate to contact us!
categories: Beauty & Health, Grocery & Food, Pet supplies
